summary.text: Kate Nugent is a Democratic state representative from the Chittenden-10 District who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Kate Nugent was born in Melrose, Massachusetts, and lives in Vermont.
Nugent earned a B.A. in international relations and French from Colgate University and an M.A. in renaissance and medieval women's literature from the University of South Carolina.
Nugent's career experience includes working in the nonprofit sector, including as executive director of the Winooski Partnership for Prevention.
